plan.capture_preroll_scope: source prefixed by declared capture time; transmitter UTC unchanged, but absolute capture-clock channel trajectories are sampled later
plan.channel_tail_seconds_scope: complete causal route-composed fixed-antenna complex-voltage FIR support, common first-to-last retained lag across selected routes
plan.cn0_reference_plane: common normalized E reference at the declared 1000 km range before route, spreading, reflection, and fixed antenna projection; fixed additive receiver noise
plan.hf_trajectory_clock_scope: analytic HF physical time = output capture sample/Fs + offset; source/calendar, additive noise and every residual Doppler/drift term retain capture time; eikonal phase/delay reference stays at physical time zero
plan.seed_scope: seed controls stochastic path realization; noise_seed overrides only additive-noise streams; hf_trajectory_seed overrides immutable critical-frequency knot seeds by xor with 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15*(path_index+1), modulo 2^64; resolved per-path seeds are in scenario.channel.paths

vector_two_hop.branch_error_accounting_scope: route-specific mesh, refined-order and frequency errors preserve both direct and staged checks; coherent physical allowance uses the maximum of direct/staged error within each category, then sums categories and active routes plus the larger moving-angle direct/staged error
vector_two_hop.fade_statistic_scope: uniform frequency-integrated power statistic over the declared symmetric band; this is not DATA-symbol-weighted
vector_two_hop.fixed_angle_carrier_diagnostic_scope: fixed-angle carrier comparison is reported separately as a diagnostic and is not the moving-angle production response
vector_two_hop.interpolation: route-specific complex-voltage FIR coefficients over the declared physical displacement law; physical output time is (output_sample-32)/1920; F retarded range uses two bounded substitutions with L(d)=hypot(X,2(hF+d)), central-image phase and Rref/L(d), then nine-node P/Q moving-angle interpolation with independently checked 0.0006 voltage error
vector_two_hop.moving_angle_fit_layout: nine uniform height nodes d/A=-1..1 in 0.25 steps; nine RF offsets -960..+960 Hz in 240 Hz steps; ascending spatial order and TE/TM ports; pre-F P then post-F Ey/Ez; dephased to nominal half-range with d-dependent chromatic correction
vector_two_hop.moving_angle_interpolation: P/Q barycentric interpolation over nine fixed height nodes with weights (-1)^i*C(8,i); exact central-image carrier phase and implicit half-flight retarded-time corrections remain analytic
vector_two_hop.numerical_scope: selected local planar return corridors; full diffraction orders and TE/TM retained through route composition until fixed antenna projection; other arrivals, Earth curvature, finite-beam spreading, and global path coverage are outside this model
vector_two_hop.point_source_scope: conditional planar retarded return approximation; not an exact point-source Green function

plan.vector_two_hop_angular_interpolation_sco: production F interaction uses nine-node uniform-height P/Q angular interpolation; fixed-angle carrier comparison remains a separate diagnostic, not the production response; moving-angle and staged errors are separately reported and gated at 0.0006 voltage
plan.vector_two_hop_exposure_scope: selected local planar two-Es ground-bounce and one-F return corridors; numerical support does not prove global path completeness, other arrivals, finite-beam coverage, Earth-curvature effects, or field occurrence probability
plan.vector_two_hop_physical_time_scope: physical output time is (output_sample - 32)/1920; F-region retarded range uses two bounded substitutions with L(d)=hypot(X,2(hF+d)) and flight time L(d)/(2c), from the common receiver output time

scenario.assumptions: Constructed local planar return corridors for two Es ground-bounce and one F route through two Es transmissions; full diffraction orders and TE/TM are retained through composition until the selected receive antenna projection. Earth curvature, other arrivals, finite beam effects, natural occurrence distributions, and global coverage beyond these selected local corridors are outside this model. One predeclared receive-axis index from the finite 36-axis grid is used independently of receiver outcomes. A causal sampled complex-voltage FIR covers Â±384 Hz at 1920 Hz and retains the full common lag support; no per-window normalization is applied. Physical output time is (output_sample-32)/1920; F retarded range uses two bounded substitutions with L(d)=hypot(X,2(hF+d)), central-image carrier phase restoration and relative amplitude Rref/L(d), plus nine-node P/Q moving-angle interpolation. Moving-angle and staged voltage errors are independently checked; the fixed-angle carrier witness is diagnostic only and does not define the production response. This conditional planar return is not an exact point-source Green function. The receiver receives neither intermediate fields nor route coefficients. This is a constructed high-fidelity hypothesis, not a measured multi-hop event or field-performance claim; no Helper is used.
